result.title: PAC Learning with Query Feedback
result.summary: We study realizable multiclass PAC learning with query feedback, where each training example provides a single binary response indicating whether its true label belongs to a chosen subset from a fixed query family. Our main contribution is the query dimension, a combinatorial parameter that captures both the structure of the hypothesis class and the ability of the available queries to distinguish labels. This parameter generalizes the bandit DS dimension, which it recovers under singleton queries. We establish a sample-complexity lower bound of $Ω(D/\varepsilon)$ and an upper bound of $\widetilde{O}(D^2/\varepsilon)$, suppressing factors polylogarithmic in the number of labels and the failure probability. When the available queries can split every candidate set into two parts of comparable size, we improve the upper bound to $\widetilde{O}(D/\varepsilon)$, yielding a characterization up to logarithmic factors.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究带查询反馈的可实现多类 PAC 学习：每个样本只返回一个二值响应，说明真实标签是否属于某个查询子集；作者提出「query dimension」这一组合参数，并给出样本复杂度的上下界，在查询能均匀二分候选集时得到近乎紧确的刻画。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「查询族结构决定标签可区分性」的想法，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK 阶段选取哪类视觉证据查询、以及证据筛选的信息价值评估提供抽象度量参考，但属推测，需核查其是否可对应到具体视觉查询与停止决策。
